notes.title: ver.3.9.0 UI fixes and restored version of some analysis processes.
notes.notes:
The selection of the video file export encoder has been moved to the Settings.

Due to the high number of false detections observed in the Apex analysis process in the previous update, we have made the previous version available for use as well.
We will continue to strive for improvement in the analysis process going forward.


Please try the demo version first.

Feedback to the community or reviews.
Also, if you need urgent support, please DM from your [url=https://twitter.com/TwilightWings_]Twitter[/url] account.

notes.title: ver.3.6.1 release - bug fix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that depends on the PC environment.
Please update if you encounter any malfunctions.

notes.title: Fortnite supported - ver. 3.6.0 release
notes.notes:
Now supports Fortnite.
The implementation is still in the early stages and the accuracy will not be good yet.

Please use the trial version first.

notes.title: ver.3.5.0 release. Improved video analysis speed.
notes.notes:
We have made improvements to reduce the time required for video analysis.
We welcome your comments in the reviews, such as improvements or non-improvements.

notes.title: ver.3.0.1 Release
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that clipping may stop in the middle when multiple files are selected at once.

Is it a problem? If you think so, please feel free to DM us on Twitter.
https://twitter.com/TwilightWings_

notes.title: ver.1.0.2 update
notes.notes: The cause of the huge memory consumption during the highlight search was found and fixed.

notes.title: ver.1.0.1 update
